components.purpose: Ask one question — archive this agent? — with the consequence stated before the button.
components.current_implementation: max-w-2xl centered column, space-y-4, p-6 — the same skeleton as every confirmation page. In the refused state it renders h1 'Cannot archive' plus the platform's reason in a notice block (bg-notice-subtle, border-notice-border, role=alert kept) and offers no form; nothing is styled as though retrying could help. Since `a-refusal-lands-where-someone-reads-it` (#240) BOTH branches mount `<CarriedProblem>` under the h1 — the refused branch is where a bounced archive lands by construction (a spent confirmation means the re-run describe declines), so 'Cannot archive' and 'your archive was refused' render as two stacked facts: the danger-tinted carried banner above the notice-tinted refusal-to-mint.
constraints: Archiving is presented as recoverable and MUST NOT be described or styled as deletion — openspec/specs/agent-authoring/spec.md:202 ('present archiving as recoverable'). The submit copy says 'and free its slot', which is the benefit, not a loss.

The page renders whole from one server round trip and holds no client state — the only client code is PerformButton ('use client', useFormStatus), which reports that a submit is in flight and nothing else. A design requiring further client-side interactivity changes behavior and is requires-spec-change.
In the refused state the reason paragraph keeps role=alert.

components.purpose: Show the refusal that bounced a submitted archive back to the person who clicked it.
components.current_implementation: The shared `CarriedProblem` component, mounted unconditionally on both post-connection branches (it renders null without a problem). DT-0004's treatment: rounded-gc-2 border-danger-default bg-danger-subtle p-4 text-sm text-text-primary with role=alert, opening with a semibold 'Refused:' prefix so the state is named as well as tinted — visually distinct from the consequence block on the proposal branch and from the notice block on the refused branch.
constraints: This is a failed attempt, not advisory — it may take a stronger role than the consequence block, but 'notice never borrows danger's colour' (system.json principle) still binds the consequence block beside it.

Mounted on every branch — `a-problem-redirect-is-read-where-it-lands.test.ts` derives this page as a problem destination and fails any render branch that drops the reason. A design that suppresses it on the refused branch changes behavior and is requires-spec-change.

components.purpose: State what archiving does, in BattleGrid's own words, before the button that does it.
components.current_implementation: DT-0004: the consequence-callout's consequence role — rounded-gc-2 border-consequence-border bg-consequence-subtle p-4 text-sm text-text-primary, role=alert kept, the platform's sentence verbatim.
constraints: The text is the platform's verbatim consequence sentence — a design must not paraphrase, truncate, or summarize it.
Consequence outranks everything on a screen (system.json principle) — this block must not become lighter than the buttons below it.

components.purpose: Carry the archive decision: one committing button, one visible way out.

actions.effect: POSTs the server action with agentId, expectedRevision, confirmationToken; success lands on /agents, refusal redirects back here with ?problem=

components.current_implementation: flex flex-col gap-3, tablet:flex-row tablet:flex-wrap — buttons stack full-width under the tablet breakpoint, sit inline above it; three hidden inputs carry the confirmation binding.
constraints: The hidden binding (agentId, expectedRevision, confirmationToken) is the confirmation ceremony — the form must keep exactly one submit path.
Cancel must remain a visible peer of the submit, never a text link beneath it (DT-0002 ruling, restated in control.ts).

components.purpose: Commit the archive. Named with the agent and the benefit: 'Archive <name> and free its slot'.
components.current_implementation: BUTTON_PRIMARY constant from control.ts — accent.default bg, min-h-control (size.control.min, 44px, tokenised by DT-0003), rounded-gc-2, hover to accent.hover over duration-fast, active holds hover at duration-instant. Page adds w-full tablet:w-auto for the mobile stack. Still no pending/loading state between click and redirect — filed as #153, behavior not styling. DT-0022 added the primitive's `disabled` treatment to this constant — bg.sunken ground, text.disabled label, border.subtle edge and cursor not-allowed, stated rather than an opacity. DT-0022 defined the primitive's `disabled` treatment on this constant, but **nothing in the product enters it** — so it is not listed as a state of this surface. system.json declares it and DT-0022 styles it; a surface claiming a state it cannot reach is the same fiction DT-0003 refused for the ghost and danger variants.
constraints: Deliberately NOT danger-styled — DT-0002's ruling, restated in control.ts: archive is the legitimate action; the weight belongs on the consequence block. A design ticket restyling this as danger contradicts a decided ruling.
Styling changes go through the BUTTON_PRIMARY constant in control.ts, shared by every committing submit in the product — not a per-page className.
Focus ring comes from the one global rule in globals.css — do not add a per-element ring.

components.purpose: Leave the agent active and go back to it.
components.current_implementation: An anchor wearing BUTTON_SECONDARY — inline-flex centering, min-h-control, and since DT-0004 a hover treatment (border-border-strong + bg-bg-sunken over duration-fast; active holds it at duration-instant). Page adds w-full tablet:w-auto for the mobile stack.
constraints: Must remain an anchor (pure navigation, no form participation) and must remain a visible peer of the submit.
Styling changes go through the BUTTON_SECONDARY constant in control.ts.

components.purpose: Turn away a request without authority, with the one remedy that works: connect.
components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component (require-connection.tsx): h1 + message, and since DT-0006 the connect link is an anchor wearing BUTTON_SECONDARY — the way in as a target, not a sentence, at the 44px floor with secondary's hover. Used by every authenticated page, so this treatment is inherited everywhere.
constraints: Every no-authority cause renders this same page by design (see design W-C) — a design must not invent per-cause variants.

flows.name: Archive an agent
steps: read the consequence in BattleGrid's words
land on /agents with the row moved

flows.name: Archive is refused after submit
steps: problem banner states the reason above the still-usable form

flows.name: The bounce lands on the refused branch
steps: submit; the confirmation is refused (most often already spent — the first press succeeded)
redirected back here with ?problem=; the re-run describe declines to re-mint
'Cannot archive' renders with the carried refusal above the notice block — both facts, neither replacing the other

accessibility.notes: All three message blocks carry role=alert. Focus ring is global (focus-visible, 2px). Every state change is a full navigation; the only client code is PerformButton, which reports that a submit is in flight and nothing else.
